## ScheduledClicker 1.1.1 — macOS Dark Mode usability fix

This maintenance release fixes the macOS interface in Dark appearance and keeps the existing Windows 11 and macOS scheduling behavior unchanged.

### Downloads

- `ScheduledClicker.exe` — portable Windows 11 application.
- `ScheduledClicker-macOS-universal.zip` — macOS 13 Ventura or later; Apple silicon and Intel.
- `ScheduledClicker-macOS-universal.sha256` — a small text file containing the official SHA-256 checksum for verifying the macOS ZIP after download.

### Changes

- Fixed unreadable white-on-white controls when macOS uses Dark appearance.
- Added an adaptive AppKit background and clearer scheduling layout.
- Shows only the selected exact-time or delay inputs.
- Added automated Aqua and Dark Aqua contrast/visibility smoke tests plus rendered UI evidence.
- Kept the existing one-time single/double-click scheduling behavior unchanged.

### Verification

- Windows core tests: 10/10 passed; launch smoke test and Microsoft Defender scan passed.
- macOS core tests: 21/21 passed.
- Aqua and Dark Aqua UI tests passed.
- Universal architecture (`x86_64 arm64`), plist validation, ad-hoc signature, package inspection, and SHA-256 checks passed.
- The user verified the scheduling function and improved Dark appearance on a MacBook Air.

### Known limitations

- The Windows executable is unsigned.
- The macOS application is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized.
- Fixed coordinates can become unsafe if the target window moves or changes.
- Keep the desktop awake, logged in, unlocked, and unchanged until execution.

## 繁體中文

此版本修正 macOS 深色外觀下的白字白底問題，重新整理排程介面，並保留原有 Windows 11 與 macOS 指定時間／倒數延遲、單擊／雙擊功能。使用者已在 MacBook Air 確認功能與新版介面可讀。下載後可使用 `.sha256` 文字檔核對 macOS ZIP 是否與官方發布檔完全一致。
